name: hsn-common
description: HSN codes for goods a small Indian shop or trading business commonly sells, with the GST rate on each, from Notification 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025 (GST 2.0). Rates are total GST: the notification states central tax (2.5 means 5% GST, 9 means 18% GST). Later amendments to that notification were checked - 19/2025 (tobacco, from 1 February 2026), 01/2026 (beverages, from 1 May 2026) and 02/2026 (fertilisers and tyres, from 1 November 2026) - and none of them touches an entry here. Goods not listed in Schedule I, III, IV, V or VI of the notification fall in Schedule II at 18% (serial 639, the residuary entry). Deliberately small: each entry was read in the notification itself. Coverage runs to the end of FY 2026-27 because nothing further is notified for it; re-check after any GST Council meeting.

sources.title: Notification 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated 17 September 2025, effective 22 September 2025
sources.notes: Replaces the 2017 goods rate notification. Schedule I is 2.5% central tax (5% GST), Schedule II 9% (18%), Schedule III 20% (40%), Schedule IV 1.5% (3%), Schedule V 0.125%, Schedule VI 0.75%. Gazette G.S.R. 641(E).

sources.title: Notification 02/2026-Central Tax (Rate) dated 27 October 2026, effective 1 November 2026
sources.notes: Checked: changes only fertilisers (Schedule I, S. No. 237) and tyres (4012 added to Schedule I, other tyres reworded in Schedule II), from 1 November 2026. Its closing note records 01/2026 as the previous amendment to 9/2025. No entry below is affected. Gazette G.S.R. 921(E).

entries.description: Coffee roasted, whether or not decaffeinated; coffee husks and skins; coffee substitutes containing coffee in any proportion [other than coffee beans not roasted]
Tea, whether or not flavoured [other than unprocessed green leaves of tea]
Rice, pre-packaged and labelled
entries.note: The 5% entry is for pre-packaged and labelled rice; loose rice sold unpacked is not covered by this entry.

entries.description: Wheat or meslin flour, pre-packaged and labelled

Cane or beet sugar and chemically pure sucrose, in solid form including refined sugar containing added flavouring or colouring matter, sugar cubes [other than jaggery of all types, khandsari sugar, rab]
Seviyan (vermicelli); pasta, whether or not cooked or stuffed, such as spaghetti, macaroni, noodles, lasagne, gnocchi, ravioli, cannelloni; couscous
Pastry, cakes, biscuits and other bakers' wares, whether or not containing cocoa; un-fried or un-cooked snack pellets made by extrusion; extruded or expanded savoury or salted products
Namkeens, bhujia, mixture, chabena and similar edible preparations in ready for consumption form, whether or not pre-packaged and labelled
entries.note: Pan masala (2106 90 20) is 40% and is not this entry.

entries.description: Medicaments for therapeutic or prophylactic uses, put up in measured doses or in forms or packings for retail sale, including Ayurvedic, Unani, homoeopathic, siddha or bio-chemic medicaments
Hair oil, shampoo
entries.note: Other hair preparations (dyes, creams, gels) are 18% under Schedule II, S. No. 62.

entries.description: Toothpaste
entries.note: Tooth powder and dental floss are separate 5% entries in the same schedule; other oral hygiene preparations are 18%.

entries.description: Agarbatti, lobhan, dhoop batti, dhoop, sambraani
Toilet soap (other than industrial soap) in the form of bars, cakes, moulded pieces or shapes
entries.note: Soap other than toilet soap, and liquid or cream skin-washing preparations, are 18% under Schedule II, S. No. 66.

entries.description: Cartons, boxes and cases of corrugated or non-corrugated paper or paper board
Brochures, leaflets and similar printed matter, whether or not in single sheets
entries.note: Books and other printed products are in the exemption notification 10/2025-Central Tax (Rate); check it before billing books.

entries.description: Woven fabrics of cotton
Articles of apparel and clothing accessories, knitted or crocheted, of sale value not exceeding Rs 2500 per piece
Articles of apparel and clothing accessories, knitted or crocheted, of sale value exceeding Rs 2500 per piece
entries.note: The rate turns on the sale value per piece (Rs 2500), not on the material. Chapter 62 (not knitted) has the same two-tier split.

entries.description: Umbrellas and sun umbrellas (including walking-stick umbrellas, garden umbrellas and similar umbrellas)
Table, kitchen or other household articles of iron and steel; utensils
entries.note: Iron or steel wool and pot scourers of the same heading are 18% under Schedule II, S. No. 301.

entries.description: Bicycles and other cycles (including delivery tricycles), not motorised
Spectacles, corrective (including goggles for correcting vision)
entries.note: Spectacles and goggles other than corrective are 18% under Schedule II, S. No. 558.

entries.description: Furniture wholly made of bamboo, cane or rattan
Other furniture (other than furniture wholly made of bamboo, cane or rattan) and parts thereof
Toys like tricycles, scooters, pedal cars etc. (including parts and accessories thereof) [other than electronic toys]
Electronic toys like tricycles, scooters, pedal cars etc. (including parts and accessories thereof)
Tooth brushes including dental-plate brushes

Organic surface-active agents (other than soap); washing preparations (including auxiliary washing preparations) and cleaning preparations, other than those of heading 3401 [other than sulphonated castor oil, fish oil or sperm oil]
Tableware, kitchenware, other household articles and hygienic or toilet articles, of plastics

Registers, account books, order books, receipt books, letter pads, memorandum pads, diaries and similar articles, binders, folders, file covers, business forms, of paper or paperboard [other than note books and exercise books]
entries.note: Note books and exercise books are carved out of this entry and have their own entry; check the schedules for 4820 20 before billing them.

entries.description: Footwear with outer soles of rubber, plastics, leather or composition leather and uppers of leather
entries.note: Footwear of textile uppers (6404) and other footwear (6405) are also 18%, at S. Nos. 205 and 206.

entries.description: Padlocks and locks (key, combination or electrically operated), of base metal; clasps and frames with clasps, incorporating locks; keys for any of the foregoing articles
Screws, bolts, nuts, coach screws, screw hooks, rivets, cotters, cotter-pins, washers (including spring washers) and similar articles, of iron or steel

Air or vacuum pumps, air or other gas compressors and fans; ventilating or recycling hoods incorporating a fan, whether or not fitted with filters; gas-tight biological safety cabinets [other than bicycle pumps, other hand pumps and parts of air or vacuum pumps and compressors of bicycle pumps]

Automatic data processing machines and units thereof (computers, laptops and their units); magnetic or optical readers, machines for transcribing data onto data media in coded form and machines for processing such data, not elsewhere specified or included
Electro-mechanical domestic appliances, with self-contained electric motor, other than vacuum cleaners of heading 8508
All goods of heading 8517 (telephone sets, smartphones, routers and other apparatus for the transmission or reception of data)

Electrical apparatus for switching or protecting electrical circuits or for making connections to or in electrical circuits (switches, relays, fuses, surge suppressors, plugs, sockets, lampholders and other connectors, junction boxes), for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 volts
Electrical filament or discharge lamps including sealed beam lamp units and ultra-violet or infra-red lamps; arc lamps
Insulated (including enamelled or anodised) wire, cable and other insulated electric conductors, whether or not fitted with connectors; optical fibre cables
Ball point pens; felt tipped and other porous-tipped pens and markers; fountain pens; stylograph pens and other pens; pen and pencil holders; parts of the foregoing
